{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] 

==Ingredients==

* 6 large [[Cookbook:English Muffins|English muffins]], split and buttered
* Grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Hot Dog|frankfurters]]
* 1 can (10.5 ounces) [[Cookbook:Pizza Sauce|pizza sauce]]
* 1 cup (4 ounces) shredded [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Oven|Oven]]
* [[Cookbook:Broiling|Broiler]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
# Sprinkle buttered muffins with Parmesan cheese.
# [[cookbook:Toast|Toast]] under [[Cookbook:Broiling|broiler]] until golden brown.
# Place 1½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] of shredded cheddar cheese on each muffin.
# Cut frankfurters crosswise in ¼-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] slices; arrange on muffins.
# Top each with about 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] of pizza sauce, and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of mozzarella cheese.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 12–15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
